description: Beta climate post-processing output at position (0,0) with seed 12345 (raw generators from seed_beta_climate, formula now in minecraft:beta/temperature and beta/vegetation JSON). Self-recorded from our own sampler by beta_climate_postprocess_values_match_fixture, which is the only reader: a drift guard, not a parity check. Re-recorded when LegacyRandom::next_f64 went from a 30-bit mantissa to java.util.Random's exact 53-bit one; the draw count per value is unchanged, so only the precision of the noise moved.
